Yes — everything we've walked through matches what I had in mind. Saving a link with the details filled in, seeing it in my library, clicking through to the site, tagging and reusing tags, filtering, the instant search, and the read-later marking and view all feel right.

One thing I haven't seen yet that I'd expect as part of "managing" my bookmarks: once something's saved, I'd want to be able to tidy it up — fix a title or tags, or remove a link I no longer want. As long as that's coming, I'm happy with where we are.
